content.title: Will There Be an 'Age of Attraction' Reunion? What to Know
content.text: The "Age of Attraction" finale saw four couples decide to continue with their relationships, despite significant age gaps, and one couple go their separate ways. Now, we'll find out who really stayed together after the cameras stopped rolling.Luckily, we won't have to wait long for answers since Netflix just announced that an "Age of Attraction" Season 1 reunion special is on the way. When will the reunion debut and how can you tune in? Here's everything we know so far.When Is the 'Age of Attraction Season 1 Reunion? The Season 1 "Age of Attraction" reunion will premiere on Wednesday, April 1 at 4 p.m. PT / 7 p.m. ET.How to Watch the ‘Age of Attraction Season 1 ReunionTypically, Netflix reunions air on the streaming service. This time, however, the “Age of Attraction” reunion will air as an episode of The Viall Files, aka the podcast of “Age of Attraction” host Nick Viall. Viall's wife and "Age of Attraction" co-host Natalie Joy will also interview stars of the reality series during the special episode of the podcast.Who Will Appear in the Reunion?In addition to the five couples who made it to the Season 1 finale, viewers can also expect to see Vanelle and Jorge, who went their separate ways early on after moving in together. However, a trailer for the reunion suggests that Pfeiffer, who committed to Derrick in the season finale, was not present for the reunion.Here's a full list of the cast members who appear in the reunion:Theresa John Vanessa Logan Libby Andrew Derrick Leah Chris Vanelle Jorge What to Expect from the Reunion A trailer for the reunion teases some drama. The tension between Theresa and John is apparent as John says, "I don’t really feel comfortable, like, airing this out.""Well, that's why we're here," Theresa replies."John, is there anything you would like to clear up in this moment?" Joy then asks.Later in the trailer, John expresses frustration with Theresa, saying, "I don’t deserve to date someone who texts me, ‘I feel disgusting with you.’"Leah also has an emotional moment, seemingly with Chris, as she says, "You took that from me."Later in the trailer, Chris says he "wanted to go home" after four days.Logan addresses Vanessa in another scene, saying, "I mean, we have gone through a lot of s---.""I don’t want to cry," Vanessa replies.Vanelle speaks to Jorge as she says, “In my mind, you were literally like my husband."Theresa later accuses Jorge of "gaslighting" everyone while he's speaking.Andrew and Libby's relationship takes center stage as Andrew says, "It's not easy," and Libby says she still hasn't met Andrew's daughters.
